# Herdown

Herdown helps users turn webpages, documents, and images into clean Markdown and structured data for AI tools.

Primary site:
- https://herdown.com/

Core capabilities:
- Webpage to Markdown
- Sitemap crawl
- Website to Markdown multi-page crawl: https://herdown.com/website-to-markdown
- API access
- MCP access
- CLI access
- Browser extension
- Skills and extraction rules
- URL to Markdown: https://herdown.com/url-to-markdown
- HTML to Markdown: https://herdown.com/paste-to-markdown
- TXT to Markdown: https://herdown.com/txt-to-markdown
- PDF, PPT, and Excel use the local MarkItDown tool: https://herdown.com/pdf-to-markdown
- Help: https://herdown.com/docs
- Docs: https://herdown.com/docs
- FAQ: https://herdown.com/faq
- Blog: https://herdown.com/blog
- HTML to Markdown for AI guide: https://herdown.com/blog/how-to-convert-html-to-markdown-for-ai
- Best Markdown converter for AI agents: https://herdown.com/blog/best-markdown-converter-for-ai-agents
- Markdown for agents tools workflow: https://herdown.com/blog/markdown-for-agents-tools

Documentation topics:
- Quick start for webpage to Markdown
- REST API authentication and parse requests
- MCP, CLI, browser extension, and local Skill usage
- Dify, Coze, FastGPT, and n8n workflow handoff
- Local MarkItDown and Unlimited-OCRSkill
- Quota, payment, privacy, and security rules

Do not treat Herdown as a full knowledge base or question answering product.
